summary: RETEST after main agent's two fixes to auth_v2 (TokenResp.refresh_token Optional + @limiter.limit on /login). Result: 20/20 PASS (100%). Both iteration-1 bugs are CLOSED: (1) POST /api/auth/v2/login with client_type='native' now returns refresh_token in the JSON body (verified via test_login_native_returns_refresh_in_body and manual curl → 'has refresh_token: True'). (2) X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset / Retry-After headers are now emitted on /api/auth/v2/login 429 responses (verified via test_rate_limit_headers_present after 5 requests: x-ratelimit-limit=5). No regressions detected: web-client flow still sets HttpOnly refresh cookie without leaking token in body, refresh rotation works, logout revokes the session, brute-force lockout still returns 429, legacy /api/auth/login still returns 200 with access_token+user, A40 Basic Auth on /api/wp-json/wp/v2/comments still 200/401 as expected, health probes, menu WebSocket auto-reload, media upload (legacy fallback), presign 503, .exe rejection, audit_log ingestion and startup fail-fast validator ALL PASS.

minor.issue: Web-client response body now contains `"refresh_token": null` because Pydantic Optional[str]=None serialises the field as null. Cookie flow itself is unaffected (HttpOnly cookie is still set correctly), but the null key on the wire is slightly noisy. Fix (optional): add `response_model_exclude_none=True` to @router.post('/login', ...) or explicitly pop the key for web clients.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: use `response_model_exclude_none=True` on /api/auth/v2/login so the JSON body no longer carries `refresh_token: null` for web clients (cosmetic).

Consider decorating the remaining /api/auth/v2/* routes (register, refresh, change-password, logout) with @limiter.limit(LIMITS.register / .refresh / .change_pass) — main-agent already covered /login, but the others in build_auth_router still have no slowapi rules.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 3774 lines — consider splitting into routers/*.py modules.
auth_v2.py: refresh_token key with value null on web-client responses is a Pydantic default; using `response_model_exclude_none=True` keeps the shape clean and avoids clients reacting to the null.

startup_check.py is still imported but NOT invoked at backend startup (only when run directly); wiring it into server.py startup would make supervisorctl restart fail-fast on broken .env in production too.

rca_of_issue: Iteration-1 bugs are fully closed. Bug (1) refresh_token missing in body: RCA was TokenResp Pydantic model omitting the field — main agent added `refresh_token: Optional[str] = None` in auth_v2.py:325. Verified with test + curl. Bug (2) missing X-RateLimit-* headers: RCA was no @limiter.limit decorator on /api/auth/v2/login — main agent added `@_rl.limit(_LIMITS.login)` on auth_v2.py:334. Verified with test that provokes 429 (headers appear on the 429 response as expected from slowapi with headers_enabled=True). Side-effect worth noting: because slowapi now caps /login at 5/min per IP, any test suite hammering login from a single IP must either flush the in-memory window (backend restart) or space its requests — I encoded this in the test infra so the suite is self-contained.
